items.album: Africa Oyé 2026 @ Sefton Park (Liverpool; Saturday 20th & Sunday 21st June 2026)
items.excerpt: Africa Oyé returns to Sefton Park on 20 and 21 June, and Liverpool gets it back after a fallow year in 2025. The UK's largest African and Caribbean music festival, which drew over 80,000 people to its last edition in 2024, returns with a bill that spans Lagos, Bamako, Kinshasa, Maputo, Accra and Port of Spain across two days.
